word.name: Name
field.invalidPhone: Enter an 11-digit mobile number such as 01712345678.
confirm.title: Are you sure?
err.INVALID_INPUT: Some of the information is not valid. Check the highlighted fields and try again.
err.NOT_FOUND: That record could not be found. It may have been removed. Refresh and try again.
err.NEGATIVE_STOCK: Not enough stock for {product}. Available: {available}. Reduce the quantity or receive stock first.
err.DAY_CLOSED: The day {closedDate} is closed, so nothing can be posted on or before it. Post on a later date, or ask the Owner to reopen the day.
err.CREDIT_LIMIT: This sale would take the customer over their credit limit. Collect a payment or ask a manager.
err.APPROVAL_REQUIRED: A manager must approve this. Ask a manager to sign in and approve.
err.HAS_RETURNS: This invoice has returns. Void the returns first.
err.OVER_RETURN: You are returning more than was sold or bought.
err.DUPLICATE_INVOICE: This company invoice number was already entered ({docNo}). Give a reason to enter it again.
err.OVER_PAYMENT: The paid amount is more than the total.
err.PERMISSION: Your role cannot do this. Ask the Owner or a manager.
err.IN_USE: This record is in use and cannot be removed. Archive it instead.
err.PACK_SIZE_LOCKED: The {pack} size ({factor}) is already on invoices, so it cannot change. Add a new pack for the new size (for example "Box 24") and keep the old one.
err.AUTH_FAILED: Wrong PIN or password. Try again.
err.LOCKED_OUT: Too many wrong attempts. Wait a few minutes, or use the recovery code.
err.DB_NEWER: This data was made by a newer version of PetraDMS. Install the latest version.
err.IO_FAILED: A file could not be read or written. Check the folder and disk space.
err.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong. Your data is safe. If it keeps happening, export diagnostics from Settings and send them to support.
empty.title: Nothing here yet
sg.title: Style guide
sg.sampleBody: Dialogs spring in and the scrim fades. Press Esc to close.
sg.emptyBody: Products you add will appear here.
sg.lite: Lite mode switched animations to Reduced because this computer is slow. You can change this in Settings.
err.DB_CORRUPT: The data file is damaged and no backup could be used. Contact support before doing anything else.
err.BACKUP_FAILED: The backup could not be made. Check that the backup folder exists and the disk has space.
err.BACKUP_INVALID: This file is not a usable PetraDMS backup. It may be damaged or incomplete.
err.IMPORT_INVALID: This file cannot be imported. Check that it is a CSV with a heading row and no more than 20,000 rows, and that the columns are matched.
err.IMPORT_HAS_ERRORS: Some rows have problems, so nothing was imported.
err.DEMO_UNAVAILABLE: Demo data can only be loaded into an empty shop, and can only be cleared while demo mode is on.
